prompt: Of the Jason Statham movies that came out the year Dennis Hopper died, which could he have lived to see the premiere of?
answer: None. Dennis Hopper died on May 29, 2010. Jason Statham’s 2010 films—*The Expendables* and *13*—premiered later that year, in August and September respectively, so Hopper could not have seen either premiere.
